# vaultflipper (companion)

Command-line companion for [VaultFlipper](https://github.com/its-sven/vaultflipper): fetches logins from Bitwarden and Vaultwarden with the official `bw` CLI, encrypts them for your Flipper Zero and your PIN, and sends them over USB.

```bash
uv run vaultflipper --help
```

See the [project README](https://github.com/its-sven/vaultflipper#readme) for setup and security notes.
